notes:
- Plan works like a real calendar: repeat every N days or weeks on the days you choose, monthly or yearly, and end after a date or a number of times
- Change or delete one event, this and the following ones, or the whole series, with Undo
- Tap an event for its details: when, repeat, reminders, place, notes and the meeting link
- A new All view lists every event and task, with search, ticking several to delete, and deleting a date range
- Events can last several days, have more than one reminder, and need a name before they save
- Tasks can repeat ("every monday" in the add box works too), get a time, and remind you on the notch
- Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI and Gemini CLI now connect and report to the notch like Claude Code
- The colour picker picks the real colour (it gave black on many PCs) and its shortcut can be changed
- Updates show along the bottom of the open notch with a Restart button, and each update tells you what changed
